title: Pending MED+250 Cloudflare least-privilege account verification
summary: The intended account and production deployment are visible, but the current interactive OAuth session has broad write permissions and cannot satisfy the least-privilege production gate.

checks.name: Authenticated account visibility
checks.detail: Wrangler reports an authenticated interactive session with exactly one visible account; account identifiers and operator identity are omitted from this artifact.

checks.name: Production deployment visibility
checks.detail: The production Worker reports a current Wrangler deployment with one version receiving all traffic, and the seven-route live deployment verifier passes.

checks.name: Custom-domain configuration
checks.detail: The production environment declares med250.gikundiro.com as an exact custom domain, disables the workers.dev route, and sets the live release mode.

checks.name: Least-privilege credential
checks.detail: The current OAuth session reports 29 permissions, including multiple unrelated account-wide write capabilities. Replace it with a credential limited to the MED+250 Worker, required route and assets, and read-only zone inspection.

checks.name: Infrastructure-owner approval
checks.detail: The named infrastructure owner must verify the replacement credential, confirm old access is revoked, and sign the completed account record.
